sections.heading: Ungo's Sugar
sections.text: Candy made in Senpou Temple, imbued with Ungo's blessing. Reduces damage to one's Vitality for a time. The blessing is received by biting the candy and taking the Ungo stance. Spiritfall is from the excess karma of man, which means one must bite the sweets hard and endure. The Senpou monks spread these sweets across Ashina as a tribute to its military heroes.
